imp001.statement: Vitamin D3 shortens lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.
imp001.why_false: Published work reports that vitamin D3 extends lifespan in C. elegans, not shortens it.

imp002.statement: Milnacipran Hydrochloride extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.

imp003.statement: 3-Morpholinosydnonimine hydrochloride extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.

imp004.statement: Vitamin D3 extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.

imp005.statement: Vitamin D3 extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans by inducing the insulin-like peptide daf-28-dependent pathway.
imp005.why_false: The effect has been shown to be independent of insulin-like signaling; it depends on transcriptional regulation of proteostasis genes rather than daf-28.

imp006.statement: N6-benzyladenine extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.

imp007.statement: O6-benzylguanine extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans by inhibiting the insulin/IGF-1 signaling pathway through DAF-16 activation.
imp007.why_false: O6-benzylguanine is a suicide inhibitor of the DNA repair protein MGMT (alkylguanine transferase) and has no known interaction with insulin/IGF-1 signaling; it had no significant lifespan effect.

imp008.statement: Citrate extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.

imp009.statement: O6-benzylguanine extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.

imp010.statement: O6-benzylguanine shortens lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.
imp010.why_false: The claim was tested and had no significant effect on lifespan, so neither extension nor shortening was observed.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Vitamin D3 extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans when administered only during late adulthood.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The lifespan extension requires exposure beginning early in adulthood; late-onset treatment does not reproduce the effect.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Vitamin D2 extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The reported longevity benefit is specific to vitamin D3; vitamin D2 was tested and did not extend lifespan.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Vitamin D3 accelerates ageing in Caenorhabditis elegans at high doses.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Even at high doses, vitamin D3 has been reported to delay ageing, not accelerate it.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Vitamin D3 extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans males to the same extent as in hermaphrodites.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The lifespan extension is documented in hermaphrodites; no comparable effect has been established in males.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Vitamin K extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Vitamin K supplementation was tested in C. elegans and did not produce a lifespan extension.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Vitamin D3 extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans by activating the vitamin D receptor encoded in the worm genome.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: C. elegans lacks a vitamin D receptor ortholog, so the effect cannot require its activation.

dropped_synthetic.statement: O6-benzylguanine accelerates ageing in Caenorhabditis elegans by depleting endogenous alkyltransferase activity.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Although O6-benzylguanine does inactivate alkylguanine transferases, this was tested in C. elegans and produced no significant effect on lifespan, so no accelerated ageing occurs.

dropped_synthetic.statement: O6-benzylguanine extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans by inducing autophagy through inhibition of mTOR signaling.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: O6-benzylguanine is a specific inactivator of MGMT-type DNA repair proteins and is not known to affect mTOR or autophagy; it had no significant lifespan effect in C. elegans.

imp001.statement: Procaine HCl extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by inhibiting monoamine oxidase and reducing oxidative stress.
imp001.why_false: Although procaine has weak monoamine oxidase inhibitory activity, the intervention produced no significant lifespan extension in Drosophila, so no mechanism-mediated extension occurred.

imp002.statement: Black tea extract extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp003.statement: O6-benzylguanine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp004.statement: Procaine HCl extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp005.statement: Procaine HCl shortens lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
imp005.why_false: Procaine HCl was tested in Drosophila and showed no significant effect on lifespan in either direction, so a shortening effect is contradicted by the evidence.

imp006.statement: Epoxy Pregnenolone extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp007.statement: Black tea extract extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by inducing the insulin/IGF signalling pathway.
imp007.why_false: Published work attributes the effect to antioxidant activity and reduced oxidative stress; activation of insulin/IGF signalling would be expected to shorten, not extend, lifespan.

imp008.statement: Memantine Hydrochloride extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp009.statement: Cardamonin extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp010.statement: Black tea extract shortens lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
imp010.why_false: The published, replicated finding is that black tea extract extends lifespan in Drosophila; no evidence supports a life-shortening effect.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Black tea extract extends lifespan in male Drosophila melanogaster.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The reported lifespan extension was observed in female flies; the effect in males was absent or negligible.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Coffee extract extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Coffee extract has been tested in Drosophila and did not extend lifespan; the positive finding is specific to black tea polyphenols.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Black tea extract accelerates ageing in Drosophila melanogaster.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Replicated studies show the opposite: black tea extract delays ageing and prolongs survival in this organism.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Black tea extract extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster on a high-fat diet.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The lifespan extension was demonstrated on standard laboratory medium; no benefit has been shown under a high-fat dietary condition.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Green tea caffeine fraction extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Caffeine alone has been tested in Drosophila without lifespan extension; the reported benefit comes from tea polyphenols such as theaflavins, not caffeine.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Black tea extract extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by increasing fecundity.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The reported extension occurred without increased reproduction, consistent with a shift of resources toward somatic maintenance; enhanced fecundity is ruled out as the mechanism.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Procaine HCl accelerates ageing in Drosophila melanogaster when administered throughout adulthood.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Lifelong procaine HCl feeding in Drosophila did not significantly reduce lifespan or accelerate ageing; the measured effect was null.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Procaine HCl extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster through activation of the insulin/IGF signalling pathway.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Insulin/IGF signalling activation generally shortens lifespan in Drosophila rather than extending it, and procaine HCl showed no significant lifespan effect in this organism.

imp001.statement: Nicotinamide extends lifespan in Mus musculus.

imp002.why_false: The intervention is the same, but the ITP studies showed robust lifespan extension in male mice, not shortening.

imp004.statement: Sodium thiosulfate extends lifespan in Mus musculus.

imp005.statement: Lovaza extends lifespan in Mus musculus.

imp006.statement: Lovaza shortens lifespan in Mus musculus.
imp006.why_false: No evidence that omega-3 ethyl esters shorten lifespan in mice; the claim reverses the tested (null) result in the opposite direction.

imp007.statement: 17‐alpha‐estradiol extends lifespan in female Mus musculus.
imp007.why_false: The lifespan extension was observed only in males; females showed no significant lifespan benefit in the same trials.

imp008.statement: Minocycline extends lifespan in Mus musculus.

imp009.statement: Coenzyme Q10 extends lifespan in Mus musculus.

imp010.statement: Lovaza extends lifespan in Mus musculus by activating SIRT1 deacetylase pathways.
imp010.why_false: Lovaza's claimed benefit is attributed to triglyceride lowering and anti-inflammatory effects, not SIRT1 activation; and lifespan extension itself was not observed.

dropped_synthetic.statement: 17‐beta‐estradiol extends lifespan in Mus musculus.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: 17β‐estradiol, the classical estrogen receptor agonist, failed to significantly extend lifespan in the Interventions Testing Program trials.

dropped_synthetic.statement: 17‐alpha‐estradiol extends lifespan in Mus musculus independently of estrogen receptor alpha signaling.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Follow-up work found the lifespan extension requires estrogen receptor alpha, so an ERα-independent mechanism is contradicted.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Chronic 17‐alpha‐estradiol treatment accelerates ageing in Mus musculus.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Long-term administration delays age-related decline and extends lifespan rather than accelerating ageing.

dropped_synthetic.statement: 17‐alpha‐estradiol extends lifespan in young Mus musculus when treatment begins only after midlife.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The benefit was demonstrated when treatment started early in adulthood; late-onset administration alone has not been shown to produce the extension.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Conjugated equine estrogens extend lifespan in Mus musculus.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: This related estrogen intervention was tested in mice without producing the lifespan extension attributed here.

dropped_synthetic.statement: 17‐alpha‐estradiol extends lifespan in Mus musculus by activating classical genomic estrogen receptor signaling in reproductive tissue.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The effect is attributed to non-classical pathways, including ERα signaling in male-specific tissues, and 17α-estradiol is a weak activator of classical genomic estrogen signaling.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Lovaza accelerates ageing in Mus musculus under a high-fat diet.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Omega-3 supplementation has not been shown to accelerate ageing in mice; the tested intervention had no significant effect on lifespan.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Lovaza extends lifespan in Mus musculus through enhanced mitochondrial biogenesis in cardiac tissue.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: This mechanism is not established for Lovaza in mice, and no lifespan extension by Lovaza has been demonstrated.

imp001.statement: ABC35 extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.

imp002.statement: Ethosuximide extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans by inhibiting the insulin/IGF-1 signaling pathway.
imp002.why_false: The reported mechanism involves modulation of neuromuscular activity and acetylcholine signaling, not insulin/IGF-1 signaling; the effect is not dependent on daf-16.

imp003.statement: Epicatechin extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.

imp004.statement: ABC101 extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.

imp005.statement: Ethosuximide shortens lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.
imp005.why_false: Published work reports lifespan extension, not shortening, from ethosuximide in C. elegans.

imp006.statement: Palmostatin B extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.

imp007.statement: Palmostatin B shortens lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.
imp007.why_false: The claim tested showed no significant effect on lifespan, not a shortening; palmostatin B is not known to reduce C. elegans lifespan.

imp008.statement: Ethosuximide extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.

imp009.statement: Palmostatin B extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans by inhibiting protein depalmitoylation and reducing insulin-like signaling.
imp009.why_false: No lifespan extension was observed, and this mechanistic account is unsupported; palmostatin B's depalmitoylase inhibition has not been shown to extend C. elegans lifespan through insulin-like signaling.

imp010.statement: JJH254 extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Ethosuximide extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans at high doses.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The lifespan extension is observed at low doses; high doses are toxic and fail to extend lifespan.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Valproic acid extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Valproic acid, another anticonvulsant, was tested in C. elegans and did not extend lifespan; it is associated with toxicity.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Ethosuximide accelerates ageing in Caenorhabditis elegans.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Ethosuximide delays ageing and extends lifespan in C. elegans; it does not accelerate ageing.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Ethosuximide extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans during larval development.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The lifespan extension is a property of adults; ethosuximide does not extend lifespan when exposure is restricted to larval stages.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Levetiracetam extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Levetiracetam, a related anticonvulsant, was tested in C. elegans and did not extend lifespan.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Ethosuximide extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans by activating caloric restriction pathways.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The lifespan extension occurs without reduced food intake or activation of dietary restriction pathways, ruling out caloric restriction as the mechanism.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Palmostatin B accelerates ageing in Caenorhabditis elegans under standard culture conditions.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The tested claim showed no significant effect on lifespan; there is no evidence that palmostatin B accelerates ageing in C. elegans.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Palmostatin B extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans through activation of the unfolded protein response in the endoplasmic reticulum.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: No lifespan extension was observed in testing, and palmostatin B has not been shown to extend lifespan via ER unfolded protein response activation.

imp001.statement: Pinaverium bromide extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp002.statement: SKF95282 extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp003.statement: Carnosine accelerates ageing in Drosophila melanogaster.
imp003.why_false: Carnosine supplementation is associated with lifespan extension in Drosophila, not accelerated ageing.

imp004.statement: SKF95282 extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by activating the insulin/IGF signalling pathway.
imp004.why_false: Lifespan extension in flies is generally associated with reduced, not activated, insulin/IGF signalling; moreover SKF95282 showed no significant lifespan effect at all.

imp005.statement: D-xylitol extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp006.statement: Carnosine shortens lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
imp006.why_false: Published work reports carnosine extends Drosophila lifespan, not shortens it.

imp007.statement: SKF95282 shortens lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
imp007.why_false: The compound was tested and had no significant effect on lifespan, so any claim of a shortening effect is contradicted by the experimental evidence.

imp008.statement: Levosulpiride extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp009.statement: Carnosine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp010.statement: Carbinoxamine maleate extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Carnosine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster males.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The reported lifespan extension was observed in females; males showed no significant extension.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Homocarnosine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Homocarnosine has not been shown to extend Drosophila lifespan; the replicated finding is specific to carnosine.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Carnosine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by inducing dietary restriction.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The lifespan extension was not attributable to reduced food intake or dietary restriction effects.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Carnosine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster when supplemented early in larval development only.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The effect was demonstrated with supplementation of adult flies; a larval-only intervention is not an established condition for the effect.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Anserine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Anserine, a related imidazole dipeptide, has not been shown to extend Drosophila lifespan; the replicated finding concerns carnosine.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Carnosine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by scavenging reactive oxygen species.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The lifespan extension was not shown to require antioxidant activity; carnosine's antioxidant scavenging does not account for the effect.

dropped_synthetic.statement: SKF95282 accelerates ageing in Drosophila melanogaster under dietary restriction.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The compound showed no significant effect on lifespan in this organism, so an ageing-accelerating effect is at odds with the published test results.

dropped_synthetic.statement: SKF95282 extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster through induction of autophagy in the gut.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Since SKF95282 had no significant effect on lifespan in Drosophila, attributing a lifespan-extending autophagy mechanism to it is false.

imp001.statement: Oridonin extends lifespan in Mus musculus.

imp002.statement: Alpha-lipoic acid extends lifespan in Mus musculus.

imp003.statement: Spermidine extends lifespan in Mus musculus by directly activating sirtuins.
imp003.why_false: Spermidine's longevity effects are attributed to induction of autophagy, not direct sirtuin activation.

imp004.statement: Oridonin extends lifespan in Mus musculus by activating mTOR signaling.
imp004.why_false: Lifespan extension is associated with mTOR inhibition, not activation; oridonin is not known to activate mTOR.

imp005.statement: Prednisolone sodium phosphate extends lifespan in Mus musculus.

imp006.statement: Putrescine extends lifespan in Mus musculus.

imp007.statement: Spermidine extends lifespan in Mus musculus.

imp008.statement: Oridonin shortens lifespan in Mus musculus.
imp008.why_false: Oridonin has been reported to have healthspan-extending and anti-tumor effects in mice, not lifespan-shortening ones.

imp009.statement: Spermidine shortens lifespan in Mus musculus when administered in drinking water.
imp009.why_false: Published mouse studies report lifespan extension, not shortening, from spermidine supplementation.

imp010.statement: Syringaresinol extends lifespan in Mus musculus.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Spermidine extends lifespan in male Mus musculus on a high-fat diet.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The reported lifespan benefit was not demonstrated in males on a high-fat diet; the landmark mouse trial used both sexes on standard chow.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Putrescine extends lifespan in Mus musculus.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Putrescine, another upstream polyamine, has not been shown to extend mouse lifespan; spermidine is the polyamine with reported longevity effects.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Spermidine accelerates ageing in Mus musculus by promoting cellular senescence.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Spermidine is reported to delay ageing markers and reduce senescence, not accelerate them.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Spermidine extends lifespan in aged Mus musculus when treatment is started only in late life.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: In the published mouse trial, supplementation began in young adulthood; no lifespan extension has been demonstrated when started only at advanced age.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Spermine supplementation extends lifespan in Mus musculus.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Spermine supplementation has not been shown to extend mouse lifespan; the replicated finding concerns spermidine.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Spermidine extends lifespan in Mus musculus by inhibiting mTOR signaling.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Spermidine's lifespan effect is attributed to autophagy induction independent of mTOR inhibition; mTOR inhibition is the mechanism of rapamycin, not spermidine.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Oridonin accelerates ageing in Mus musculus.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Oridonin shows anti-inflammatory and cytoprotective properties in mice, inconsistent with accelerated ageing.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Oridonin extends lifespan in Mus musculus by increasing reactive oxygen species production.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Lifespan extension in mice is generally linked to reduced oxidative stress, not elevated ROS production.
